headline: Chinese Healthcare Stocks Drop as US Lawmakers Threaten Cross-Border Curbs
summary: Chinese pharmaceutical and biotech shares fell after US House lawmakers warned of dependence on Chinese drug development and proposed restrictions on cross-border research collaboration.
why: Cross-border pharmaceutical development relies heavily on Chinese contract development and manufacturing operations for global drug trials.
why_moved: Chinese healthcare stocks fell following warnings from US lawmakers urging restrictions on cross-border pharmaceutical collaboration.
